What is uppercase?
Uppercase uses capital letters (A-Z). Used for acronyms, titles, and emphasis in text.
What is lowercase?
Lowercase uses small letters (a-z). The default for most body text and standard writing.
What is title case?
Title Case Capitalizes The First Letter Of Each Major Word, used in titles, headlines, and headings.
What is camelCase?
camelCase removes spaces and capitalizes each word except the first, used in programming and variable names.
What is PascalCase?
PascalCase capitalizes the first letter of each word including the first, used in class names and identifiers.
What is snake_case?
snake_case uses underscores between words in lowercase, common in programming, databases, and file names.
What is kebab-case?
kebab-case uses hyphens to separate words in lowercase, common in URLs, CSS classes, and file names.
What is SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE?
SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE is all uppercase with underscores, used for constants in programming.
How do different languages handle case?
Not all languages distinguish case. English uses case for grammar; some languages don't have uppercase/lowercase.
Why does case matter in programming?
Most programming languages are case-sensitive. 'variable' and 'Variable' are different identifiers.
What is mixed case?
Mixed case combines multiple casing styles or inconsistently applies capitalization in text.
How does case affect readability?
Proper case improves readability and word recognition speed. CamelCase scans faster than lowercase_with_underscores.
